title: Reaching into memory
description:
Each function gets the address of some memory in `rdi`:

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `get_qword(array, i)` | element i of an array of 8-byte numbers |
| `get_dword(array, i)` | element i of an array of **signed** 4-byte numbers, as a 64-bit number |
| `get_byte(bytes, i)` | byte i, as an unsigned number 0 to 255 |
| `get_sbyte(bytes, i)` | byte i, as a signed number −128 to 127 |
| `set_qword(array, i, value)` | stores value as element i (returns nothing) |
| `address_of(array, i)` | the **address** of element i of an 8-byte array, using `lea` |

In the tests, `[1, 2, 3]` is an array of 8-byte numbers and `b[1, 2, 3]` of bytes; `@` marks memory a function may change, and `=> [...]` checks it afterwards.

starter.solution.asm:
get_qword:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

get_dword:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

get_byte:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

get_sbyte:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

set_qword:
        ret

address_of:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
get_qword:
        mov     rax, [rdi + rsi*8]
        ret

get_dword:
        movsxd  rax, dword [rdi + rsi*4]
        ret

get_byte:
        movzx   eax, byte [rdi + rsi]
        ret

get_sbyte:
        movsx   rax, byte [rdi + rsi]
        ret

set_qword:
        mov     [rdi + rsi*8], rdx
        ret

address_of:
        lea     rax, [rdi + rsi*8]
        ret

hints: Element i of an 8-byte array is `[rdi + rsi*8]`; of a 4-byte array `[rdi + rsi*4]`; of bytes `[rdi + rsi]`.

Smaller values need widening: `movsxd rax, dword [...]` for a signed 4-byte number, `movzx eax, byte [...]` for an unsigned byte, `movsx rax, byte [...]` for a signed one. `lea rax, [rdi + rsi*8]` gives the address without reading memory.
rules: Work out the address with lea.
Sign-extend the signed byte with movsx.
unitTests:
test "8-byte elements"
    get_qword([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
    get_qword([10, 20, 30], 2) == 30
    get_qword([-1, 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF], 1) == 0x7FFFFFFFFFFFFFFF
test "4-byte signed elements"
    get_dword(b[1, 0, 0, 0, 0xFE, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF], 0) == 1
    get_dword(b[1, 0, 0, 0, 0xFE, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF], 1) == -2
test "bytes"
    get_byte(b[5, 200, 255], 0) == 5
    get_byte(b[5, 200, 255], 1) == 200
    get_sbyte(b[5, 200, 255], 1) == -56
    get_sbyte(b[5, 200, 255], 2) == -1
    get_sbyte(b[5, 127], 1) == 127
test "storing"
    set_qword(@[1, 2, 3], 1, 99) => [1, 99, 3]
    set_qword(@[1, 2, 3], 2, -5) => [1, 2, -5]
test "addresses"
    address_of(0x1000, 0) == 0x1000
    address_of(0x1000, 3) == 0x1018
